The numbers next to the bid/ask are the "size". The bid size displays the total amount of desired shares... The data displayed in the quote bar updates every 3 seconds; allowing you to monitor prices in real-time.Thebid-ask spreadcan indicate a stock's liquidity, which is how easy it is to buy and sell in the marketplace.
